capabilities: Export canvas files to self-contained HTML with light and dark themes
Convert canvases to editable Excalidraw JSON files
Generate Mermaid and D2 diagram source from canvas nodes and edges
Render canvases to print-ready PDF via Electron
Pick an output subfolder and re-export with last settings
extras: Desktop-only: PDF export uses Electron APIs, so it does not work on mobile. If PDF generation fails, other formats still export and a warning is shown.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to export .canvas files to shareable or editable formats outside the app.

relations.evidence: Outputs raw .excalidraw JSON (opens in Obsidian's Excalidraw plugin in compatibility mode, or in excalidraw.com)

summary: Canvas file exporter that converts .canvas files to self-contained HTML, Excalidraw JSON, Mermaid, D2, or PDF via commands and context menu.
